name: MSEI
description: The Master of Science in Entrepreneurship and Innovation is offered as a full-time, 1 year or part-time 2 year program designed for early and mid career professionals. Individuals with a passion for entrepreneurship gain critical skills and knowledge they need to create the next great companies of the future. MSEI students learn that the structure of starting and growing a new venture is an all-encompassing format for understanding an entreprenuerial career. The program fosters the entrepreneurial mindset, educating and inspiring future entrepreneurs to change the world.

name: MSSE
description: With a Master of Science in Social Entrepreneurship from the Marshall School of Business, you will experience a business education geared to the unique aspects of social impact. You will be prepared uniquely to become a leader in the field. You will balance your head and heart as you embark on a career with meaning and attack the most pressing global challenges.

name: ACAD 406
